what_happened: Task 658's specs-ignore-lib.sh predicate and git check-ignore semantics fully determined the design (repo-root .gitignore write required, not specs/.gitignore); no new mechanism needed to be invented, and a live scratch-repo probe confirmed the exact placement requirement mechanically.

Plan authoring found test-init-specs.sh Case 6 is a live collision with this task's new default: it bootstraps a fresh fixture repo (no root .gitignore), commits specs/, and asserts check-runtime-file-tracking.sh exits 0 -- which breaks once the fresh-repo path writes a root /specs/ line, because Check C then sees durable provenance as ignored. Folded check-runtime-file-tracking.sh and both test files into the plan's scope rather than leaving the research report's Recommendation 6 as a deferred gap.

verify-touched.sh's run-all.sh invocation resolves SCRIPTS_SRC/TREE_ROOTS to .claude/scripts (deployed tree) before falling back to agent-system/extensions/core, so test-init-specs.sh exercises the pre-edit deployed init-specs.sh until Phase 6's deploy-headless.sh runs -- a green verify-touched.sh result on phases 1-5 is a non-regression smoke check on the unmodified deployed tree, not a validation of the new source-store behavior. Authoritative functional verification of Phase 2's new Step 5b was performed manually: copied agent-system/extensions/core/scripts directly into disposable fixture repos (mirroring test-init-specs.sh's own build_fixture_repo idiom) and exercised both postures directly against the edited source-store script.

git check-ignore -q -- specs (the bare-path form specs_tree_is_gitignored() consults) answers 'not ignored' (rc 1) for a nonexistent specs path on disk, regardless of a matching /specs/ pattern -- confirmed by direct experiment. My first attempt at test-runtime-file-tracking.sh's new posture-aware Check C skip case built a fixture with only a committed .gitignore and no specs/ directory, so the posture predicate always reported false and Check C ran unconditionally instead of SKIPping. Fixed by mkdir -p specs/ in the fixture before invoking check-runtime-file-tracking.sh. Not a production defect (init-specs.sh's own Step 1 always creates specs/ before anything else runs), but a real fixture-authoring trap for any future test of specs_tree_is_gitignored().

Gate 3 (doc-lint) caught a genuine Rule R line_count drift in agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json for orchestrator-runtime-files.md (declared 561, actual 646 after Phase 5's additions) -- a real pre-redeploy defect, distinct from the expected deployed-script-content-drift findings. Fixed via the documented source-store invocation: REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write (the REPO_ROOT bypass pattern that avoids the deploy-root-guard's source-store refusal). After the fix, gate 3's only remaining findings are the five expected deployed-script-content-drift items for files this task edits, deferred to Phase 6's redeploy as planned.
git-commit-scoped.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json' from a commit pathspec: not contained in task #660's declared file_scope.

deploy-headless.sh's post-deploy full verification (invoked internally, not by this dispatch) reports gate 27 (lint-subject-resolution-declaration.sh) FAIL on agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh: 'calls common_test_resolve_subject without a paired common_test_declare_subject for every resolved subject'. run-all.sh is untouched by this task (grep confirms it only mentions common_test_resolve_subject in a comment, not scripts/lib/common.sh or anything else in this task's file_scope) and was last committed by an unrelated prior task. Treated as pre-existing, out-of-scope breakage per the Batch Gate Deferral directive (the complete gate set is deferred to the batch-level close, not this dispatch's responsibility) rather than fixed here. The deploy itself landed (deploy-headless.sh's own RESULT=landed_verify_red confirms the copy succeeded; only post-deploy verification is affected). Also fixed, in-scope: two self-inflicted lint collisions from Phase 5's new runbook prose (lint 17 bare git-commit-m text, lint 23 bare specs/ directory pathspec to git-commit-scoped.sh) -- both resolved by rewording the manual runbook example to avoid the flagged literal shapes; the full battery is now clean except this one unrelated pre-existing finding.
